stories.title: Hawaii is most expensive state to host Thanksgiving
stories.summary: A 16-pound turkey with all the trimmings will cost an average of $26.05 in Hawaii this year, according to a new ConsumerAffairs study.

stories.title: Mother, stepfather indicted in death of 16-year-old girl months after deputies found her remains
stories.summary: A mother and stepfather have been charged in connection with the death of a 16-year-old girl in West Virginia.

stories.title: Longs Drugs Black Friday Deals Bring Local Favorites Home
stories.summary: Holiday shopping is a chance to stock up on local favorites and share a taste of home with loved ones on the mainland.

stories.title: Trump orders the Army not to detonate bomb-making chemicals in Iowa without court approval
stories.summary: President Donald Trump on Monday said he will defer to a federal appeals court on whether the administration moves ahead with plans to detonate several tons of degraded bomb-making material at an Iowa ammunition plant.

stories.title: Cincinnati Zoo reopens hippo enclosure with changes after Fiona’s death
stories.summary: Hippo Cove has reopened with some modifications to the habitat following the death of the Cincinnati Zoo’s beloved hippo, Fiona.

stories.title: While you watch TV, it may be spying on you
stories.summary: This investigation pulls back the curtain on how some smart TVs and streaming devices quietly track everything you watch — turning your viewing habits into data that can be sold and could be used to target you.

stories.title: Feeding 10 for Thanksgiving? Here’s what the classic meal could cost
stories.summary: A Farm Bureau survey finds Thanksgiving dinner for 10 costs about $58.63 this year, up more than 6% but below the 2022 record.

stories.title: Two transported to hospital after early morning fire in Waianae
stories.summary: The Honolulu Fire Department (HFD) responded to the report just after 2 a.m. to a building on Lualualei Homestead Road.

stories.title: Shoppers who are not tech savvy may miss grocery savings, expert says
stories.summary: A ConsumerAffairs writer calls grocery apps a "technology tax" for shoppers who are not tech savvy. Here is what he suggests to avoid missing savings.

stories.title: What travelers should know as storms threaten Thanksgiving week travel
stories.summary: Storms could bring heavy rain, strong winds and flooding to the Bay Area and East Coast as millions travel for Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Episode 57 of lava fountaining ends at Kilauea
stories.summary: Peak fountain height was recorded at 650 feet above ground level (200 m) reached at 1:30 a.m. on Nov. 23, and continues as of this notice.

stories.title: Blacksmith trains apprentices to restore 1790s New Orleans ironwork
stories.summary: Darryl Reeves is one of the few blacksmiths carrying on the tradition of New Orleans ironwork, and he teaches apprentices through the New Orleans Master Crafts Guild.
